scripts.build:wasm: cargo add -p surfer-core rayon@1.10.0 || true; cargo add -p surfer-wasm wasm-bindgen-rayon@1.3.0 || true; RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory -Clink-arg=--shared-memory -Clink-arg=--max-memory=1073741824 -Clink-arg=--import-memory -Clink-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls -Clink-arg=--export=__tls_size -Clink-arg=--export=__tls_align -Clink-arg=--export=__tls_base" cargo build -p surfer-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -Z build-std=panic_abort,std --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/surfer_wasm.wasm --out-dir src/lib/client/wasm --target web
scripts.watch:wasm: nodemon --watch surfer-core/src --watch surfer-wasm/src --ext rs --exec "bun run build:wasm"
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && concurrently "vite" "bun run --watch src/server/index.ts" "bun run watch:wasm"
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:all: bun run test:rust:parallel && bun test:server && bun test:e2e && bun run test:unit
